observations.behavior: Adds credential and server parsing, temporary credential retrieval, and client input construction for Redshift batch exports, including AWS role-based and long-lived credential paths.
observations.posthog_connection: Redshift batch export destination uses AWS IAM role or stored credentials to obtain temporary Redshift credentials, then establishes a PostgreSQL-compatible client for COPY. This supports secure, short-lived authentication and account-scoped policy statements.
